findings.finding: Loader totals raw weights by vertex, normalizes, merges duplicate entries, then retains weights strictly greater than 1e-4. No general renormalization after thresholding in this routine; initially zero-total vertices receive root support. Audit asset has no positive influences removed by the threshold.
Compiled paths select a requested influence count, truncate largest-first and renormalize on truncation. The independent oracle retains all 12 maximum influences; no four-influence fidelity claim.
Explicit joint locations are arithmetic means of specified current rest-mesh vertices. Base OBJ audit does not establish morphed-character parity.

Bone Y points head to tail. Plane cross order is (third-second) cross (second-first); X is its perpendicular component relative to Y and Z completes right-handed basis. Parent-relative rest is inverse(parent global rest) times own global rest. Posed globals compose parent posed global, relative rest, local pose; skin transform removes own global rest.
